Dear Mr. Tono
Nice to meet you.
My name is Mitsutsuki Akechi, and I am a VTuber.

I would like to request an illustration to be used in my activities.

I would like to use your illustration for my activities.
For use in general activities, mainly for promotional activities on Twitter and YouTube.
For use in merchandise, fanbox returns, etc.

Features
The theme colors are light purple, white and light blue. Kikyo (Chinese bellflower) is also a motif.
Since the character is a warlord, a Japanese atmosphere is important to us.
Please use the basic costumes shown in the materials.

Format
If possible, we would like the image to be delivered in a format that allows transparency of the person.
The size of the image should be portrait-oriented so that it can be used as a cell phone wallpaper.

Thank you in advance for your time.
